description: 900-cell grid over the Boston study area. Each cell carries satellite-derived environmental predictors, street-view-derived urban morphology predictors, and spatially interpolated sensor readings (temperature and PM2.5) produced by a ridge-regression + ordinary-kriging pipeline.

grid.note: Integer 0-based index; the same id is used in every layer file.

satellite_predictors.note: All satellite and census layers were extracted to the same 900-cell grid using the extractors in src/data_extraction/. Cells are assigned the area-weighted median of the raster pixels that overlap the cell.

ndvi.label: NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index)
ndvi.source: Sentinel-2 Level-2A via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC API
ndvi.method: Median composite (cloud cover ≤ 20 %, up to 24 items). NDVI = (NIR − Red) / (NIR + Red). Aggregated to grid cells by median pixel value.

ndbi.label: NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-Up Index)
ndbi.source: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2A via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC API
ndbi.method: Median composite (cloud cover ≤ 20 %, up to 30 items). NDBI = (SWIR − NIR) / (SWIR + NIR). Aggregated to grid cells by median pixel value.

impervious_pct.label: NLCD impervious surface fraction
impervious_pct.method: Local raster file resampled and aggregated to grid cells by mean pixel value.

road_density_km_km2.label: Total road density
road_density_km_km2.source: U.S. Census TIGER/Line 2024 roads for Suffolk County, MA (downloaded via TIGER FTP)
road_density_km_km2.method: Total road-segment length clipped to each cell divided by cell area.

major_road_density_km_km2.label: Major road density
major_road_density_km_km2.method: Restricted to MTFCC codes S1100 (primary roads) and S1200 (secondary roads).
major_road_density_km_km2.note: Sparse — 789 of 900 cells have no major roads within them.

population_density_km2.label: Population density
population_density_km2.source: U.S. Census ACS 5-year estimates 2023, block-group geography (TIGER/Line 2025 block-group boundaries tl_2025_25_bg.zip)
population_density_km2.method: Block-group total population (B01003_001E) area-weighted to grid cells.

nei_emissions_tpy.label: Total EPA NEI emissions (point + area)
nei_emissions_tpy.source: EPA 2020 National Emissions Inventory — facility-level process-by-region summary (2020nei_facility_process_byregions.zip)
nei_emissions_tpy.method: Point sources located inside each cell are summed. Only cells with at least one facility have non-null values (9 of 900 cells).
nei_emissions_tpy.note: Most cells in this urban grid are null because EPA NEI point sources are sparse.

nei_area_emissions_tpy.label: EPA NEI area-source emissions
nei_area_emissions_tpy.note: All 900 cells are null — the 2020 NEI file used does not contain area-source entries for this study area.

street_view_predictors.note: All street-view metrics were extracted from Google Street View panoramas collected along the street network inside the bounding box. Images were analysed with deep-learning models from the alivestreets library. Values are aggregated per grid cell as a length-weighted mean over all street segments within the cell.
street_view_predictors.null_reason: 43 cells contain no sampled street segments (water, parks, or outside network coverage).

gvi_mean.label: Green View Index — mean
gvi_mean.method: Fraction of image pixels classified as vegetation by a semantic segmentation model (GVIFeatureExtractor). Two panorama views per point; GVI = mean of both. Length-weighted mean over all segments in the cell.

facade_area_mean.label: Facade area — mean
facade_area_mean.method: Fraction of image pixels classified as building facade. Length-weighted mean per cell.

n_cars_mean.label: Car count — mean
n_cars_mean.method: Number of cars detected in the panorama image by an object-detection model. Length-weighted mean per cell.

sky_ratio_mean.label: Sky ratio — mean
sky_ratio_mean.method: Fraction of image pixels classified as sky. Length-weighted mean per cell.

road_ratio_mean.label: Road/pavement ratio — mean
road_ratio_mean.method: Fraction of image pixels classified as road or pavement. Length-weighted mean per cell.

interpolated_satellite.note: Produced by notebooks/kriging_layers/kriging_regression_temperature.ipynb and kriging_regression_pm25.ipynb using five Boston MOD-PM sensors.
interpolated_satellite.measurement_time_window: 15:00 – 16:00 (local time); mean over all days in the overlap period

model.step_1: Ridge regression (L2 α=1.0) trained on sensor-point measurements. Predictors: ndvi, ndbi, impervious_pct (for temperature); ndvi, impervious_pct, road_density (log1p), nei_emissions (log1p), population_density (log1p) (for PM2.5). PM2.5 target log-transformed (log1p) before regression.
model.step_2: Residuals (observed − ridge prediction) fitted with a spherical/exponential/Gaussian semivariogram (exhaustive parameter search). Ordinary kriging used to interpolate residuals to all 900 grid cells.
model.step_3: Final map = ridge surface + kriged residuals. PM2.5 back-transformed with expm1.

interpolated_street_view.note: Produced by notebooks/kriging_street_view/kriging_regression_temperature.ipynb and kriging_regression_pm25.ipynb. Columns are NaN in this version because those notebooks have not yet been executed.

model.step_1: Same ridge + kriging pipeline as satellite model, but using street-view predictors: gvi_mean, facade_area_mean, n_cars_mean, sky_ratio_mean, road_ratio_mean.
model.step_2: To populate these columns, run: notebooks/kriging_street_view/kriging_regression_temperature.ipynb and kriging_regression_pm25.ipynb, then re-run this merge.

how_to_regenerate.step_1: Run notebooks/kriging_layers/extraction.ipynb to re-extract satellite layers into data/kriging_satellite/layers/
